links.comparator_used: AI used without clinician supervision for medication management, scheduling, prescription refills and patient portal messages
links.outcome: Older adults' self-reported comfort with AI use in patient-facing functions
links.effect: Medication management 74% vs 17%; scheduling 77% vs 64%; prescription refills 81% vs 54%; patient portal messages 55% vs 20% (all p < .001), supervised vs unsupervised
links.quote: Older adults were more comfortable with AI used under the supervision of a clinician rather than without supervision for diagnosis (75% vs 5%, p < .001), treatment (76% vs 5%, p < .001), medication management (74% vs 17%, p < .001), scheduling (77% vs 64%, p < .001), prescription refills (81% vs 54%, p < .001), patient portal messages (55% vs 20%, p < .001).
